Name: Mythic and Legend Arsenal - 15 Weapons with Active Skills UPDATE 3.3.0
Author: ttt1303
Description:
[center][b][size=5][color=#ffd700]MYTHIC & LEGEND ARSENAL[/color][/size][/b]
[i]15 Legendary Weapons  |  Right-Click Active Skills  |  Dynamic Fantasy VFX & Magic Auras[/i]
[b]Author:[/b] ttt1303  |  [b]Built for:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6+[/center]

[line]
[size=4][b][color=#ffa500]OVERVIEW[/color][/b][/size]
[b]Mythic & Legend Arsenal[/b] brings 15 iconic weapons inspired by world mythology, anime, and classic action games into [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b].

Unlike standard weapon mods that only add static sprites, every weapon in this pack is powered by a custom C# combat engine featuring unique [b]Right-Click Active Skills[/b], luminous [b]crescent slash waves[/b], [b]passive ground magic circles[/b], orbiting spirit orbs, and layered sound effects. Each weapon is carefully balanced around vanilla progression so you can earn them naturally as you explore, fish, and conquer the Mines.

[line]
[size=4][b][color=#ffa500]MAIN FEATURES[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]7 Unique Right-Click Active Skills:[/b] Press [b]Right-Click[/b] while holding any mythic weapon to unleash its signature ability—ranging from extending the Monkey King's staff 6 tiles forward to calling down branching lightning bolts from the sky.[/*]
[*][b]Held-Weapon Magic Auras:[/b] Equipping any of the 7 weapons manifests a rotating isometric magic circle beneath your farmer's feet along with two orbiting elemental spirit orbs.[/*]
[*][b]Enhanced Normal Attacks:[/b] Every regular Left-Click swing launches glowing dual-layer crescent sword arcs, elemental sparks, and custom weapon sound effects.[/*]
[*][b]Natural Progression Unlocks:[/b] Integrated into Stardew Valley's core gameplay loop via fishing, mine crates, Adventurer's Guild milestones, and weather/combat mail events.[/*]
[*][b]Optional Instant-Unlock Config:[/b] Includes a built-in config toggle ([i]InstantUnlockAll[/i]) to receive all 7 weapons in your mailbox on Day 1 if you want to test everything immediately.[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4][b]Mythic & Legend Arsenal - Weapons & Unlock Guide[/b][/size]

Every weapon features custom pixel art, passive elemental aura particles, enhanced basic-attack slash VFX (Left-Click), and a unique active skill with cooldown indicator (Right-Click).

[b]1. Poseidon's Trident[/b]
- [b]Stats:[/b] 24–35 DMG | Speed +4 | Defense +2 | Crit 6% (3.0x)
- [b]Active Skill (Tidal Surge):[/b] Thrusts forward to launch 3 ocean waves that damage enemies and automatically water tilled soil tiles in a 6-tile line.
- [b]How to Obtain:[/b] Caught while [b]Fishing[/b] in any water (3% chance once you reach Fishing Level 3).

[b]2. Blades of Chaos[/b]
- [b]Stats:[/b] 36–50 DMG | Speed +8 | Crit 12% (3.5x)
- [b]Active Skill (Cyclone of Chaos):[/b] Whips both chained blades in a 360-degree fiery inferno around you, dealing heavy AoE damage.
- [b]How to Obtain:[/b] Rare drop from monsters and crates in [b]The Mines (Floor 50+)[/b].

[b]3. Ruyi Jingu Bang[/b]
- [b]Stats:[/b] 42–58 DMG | Speed +2 | Area +2 | Knockback 1.8 | Crit 5% (3.0x)
- [b]Active Skill (Pillar Extension):[/b] Stretches the golden-banded staff 7 tiles forward, smashing and knocking back all enemies in a long line.
- [b]How to Obtain:[/b] Buy at the [b]Adventurer's Guild[/b] for [b]8,000g[/b] after reaching [b]Mine Floor 40[/b].

[b]4. Buster Sword[/b]
- [b]Stats:[/b] 48–66 DMG | Speed +2 | Defense +2 | Area +1 | Crit 8% (3.2x)
- [b]Active Skill (Climhazzard):[/b] Charges Mako energy and cleaves an emerald shockwave forward.
- [b]How to Obtain:[/b] Buy at the [b]Adventurer's Guild[/b] for [b]12,000g[/b] after reaching [b]Mine Floor 60[/b].

[b]5. Muramasa[/b]
- [b]Stats:[/b] 58–78 DMG | Speed +8 | Crit 15% (4.0x)
- [b]Active Skill (Phantom Slash):[/b] Performs an iaido dash leaving dark-violet spirit afterimages, ending in a [b]100% Crit[/b] cross-slash.
- [b]How to Obtain:[/b] Buy at the [b]Adventurer's Guild[/b] for [b]20,000g[/b] after reaching [b]Mine Floor 80[/b].

[b]6. Frostmourne[/b]
- [b]Stats:[/b] 68–90 DMG | Speed +4 | Defense +4 | Crit 10% (3.5x)
- [b]Active Skill (Winter's Grasp):[/b] Plunges the runeblade into the ground to erupt 5 staggered glacial spikes forward.
- [b]How to Obtain:[/b] Buy at the [b]Adventurer's Guild[/b] for [b]28,000g[/b] after reaching [b]Mine Floor 100[/b].

[b]7. Thanatos Scythe[/b]
- [b]Stats:[/b] 75–98 DMG | Speed +6 | Area +2 | Crit 14% (3.8x)
- [b]Active Skill (Soul Harvest):[/b] Sweeps a giant crescent reaper arc around you and [b]drains +5 HP[/b] per enemy defeated.
- [b]How to Obtain:[/b] Buy at the [b]Adventurer's Guild[/b] for [b]35,000g[/b] after reaching [b]Combat Level 7[/b].

[b]8. Dragonslayer[/b]
- [b]Stats:[/b] 88–118 DMG | Speed -4 | Defense +4 | Area +1 | Knockback 2.0 | Crit 4% (3.2x)
- [b]Active Skill (Earthshaker Cleave):[/b] Heavy overhead slam that crushes foes with massive knockback and [b]shatters rocks/stones[/b] in its path.
- [b]How to Obtain:[/b] Buy at the [b]Adventurer's Guild[/b] for [b]45,000g[/b] after completing the [b]Vault Bundle[/b] (unlocking the Bus).

[b]9. Tensa Zangetsu[/b]
- [b]Stats:[/b] 92–122 DMG | Speed +10 | Crit 14% (3.8x)
- [b]Active Skill (Getsuga Tenshou):[/b] Swings the Bankai blade to fire a high-speed dark-crimson crescent wave 9 tiles forward.
- [b]How to Obtain:[/b] Buy at the [b]Adventurer's Guild[/b] for [b]55,000g[/b] after reaching [b]Skull Cavern Floor 10[/b].

[b]10. Mjolnir[/b]
- [b]Stats:[/b] 96–132 DMG | Speed 0 | Defense +5 | Crit 8% (4.5x)
- [b]Active Skill (Thunderstrike):[/b] Raises Mjolnir skyward and calls down [b]3 forked lightning bolts[/b] in a line ahead.
- [b]How to Obtain:[/b] Sent via [b]Mail from the Wizard[/b] on the morning after a [b]Stormy day[/b] once you reach [b]Combat Level 5[/b].

[b]11. Gungnir[/b]
- [b]Stats:[/b] 98–128 DMG | Speed +8 | Defense +3 | Crit 16% (4.0x)
- [b]Active Skill (Gungnir's Lance):[/b] Hurls a piercing golden astral starlight beam 10 tiles forward with [b]100% Crit Chance[/b].
- [b]How to Obtain:[/b] Buy at the [b]Adventurer's Guild[/b] for [b]65,000g[/b] after reaching [b]Combat Level 9[/b].

[b]12. Excalibur[/b]
- [b]Stats:[/b] 102–128 DMG | Speed +6 | Defense +4 | Crit 12% (3.6x)
- [b]Active Skill (Excalibur Beam):[/b] Unleashes a radiant golden wave of light forward and [b]restores +12 HP[/b].
- [b]How to Obtain:[/b] Sent via [b]Mail from Marlon[/b] on a [b]Sunny morning[/b] after reaching the bottom of the Mines ([b]Floor 120[/b]).

[b]13. Yamato[/b]
- [b]Stats:[/b] 108–138 DMG | Speed +12 | Crit 18% (4.2x)
- [b]Active Skill (Judgement Cut):[/b] Flick-draws Yamato to slice space ahead in a multi-slash dimensional sphere with [b]100% Crit Chance[/b].
- [b]How to Obtain:[/b] Buy at the [b]Adventurer's Guild[/b] for [b]85,000g[/b] after reaching [b]Skull Cavern Floor 25[/b].

[b]14. Ea, Sword of Rupture[/b]
- [b]Stats:[/b] 118–152 DMG | Speed +4 | Defense +5 | Crit 14% (4.2x)
- [b]Active Skill (Enuma Elish):[/b] Spins Ea's segments to fire a devastating crimson-gold cosmic vortex beam across the screen.
- [b]How to Obtain:[/b] Buy at the [b]Adventurer's Guild[/b] for [b]110,000g[/b] after reaching [b]Combat Level 10[/b].

[b]15. Zenith[/b]
- [b]Stats:[/b] 125–165 DMG | Speed +12 | Defense +6 | Area +2 | Crit 20% (4.5x)
- [b]Active Skill (Fractal Barrage):[/b] Launches [b]7 orbiting prismatic spectral blades[/b] in a sweeping infinity arc with [b]100% Crit Chance[/b].
- [b]How to Obtain:[/b] Buy at the [b]Adventurer's Guild[/b] for [b]150,000g[/b] after reaching [b]Skull Cavern Floor 50[/b].

[b]Testing / Sandbox Mode[/b]
Want to test all 15 weapons right away? Set [b]"InstantUnlockAll": "true"[/b] in [i][CP] MythicWeapons/config.json[/i] (or via Generic Mod Config Menu) to receive the full arsenal in your mailbox on Day 1!
[line]
[size=4][b][color=#ffa500]HOW TO GET STARTED[/color][/b][/size]
[b]1. Install Required Mods:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (4.0.0 or newer)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] (2.0.0 or newer)[/*]
[/list][b]2. Install This Mod:[/b]
[list]
[*]Download the main zip file and extract it.[/*]
[*]Move [b]BOTH[/b] folders ([i][CP] MythicWeapons[/i] and [i]MythicWeaponsCode[/i]) directly into your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]3. Controls:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Left-Click:[/b] Standard melee swing with enhanced elemental slash arcs.[/*]
[*][b]Right-Click (or Action Button):[/b] Activate the equipped weapon's unique Active Skill (overrides default weapon block/special move). A cancel sound plays if the skill is still on cooldown.[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4][b][color=#ffa500]IMPORTANT INFO & CONFIGURATION[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Configuration File:[/b] Run the game once to generate [i]config.json[/i] inside [i][CP] MythicWeapons[/i] (or edit in-game via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]). Set [b]"InstantUnlockAll": "true"[/b] and sleep one night to receive all 7 weapons in your mailbox on Day 1.[/*]
[*][b]Save Compatibility:[/b] Safe to add to existing saves at any time. If you already meet the Mine Floor, Combat Level, or Desert requirements on an existing save, the shop items and mail triggers will activate automatically.[/*]
[*][b]Mod Compatibility:[/b] Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+ and other Content Patcher / SMAPI weapon mods (uses unique [i]ttt1303_[/i] item IDs to prevent conflicts).[/*]
[/list][line]
[center][i]If you enjoy wielding these legendary weapons, please consider leaving an [b]Endorsement[/b] and sharing your favorite combat screenshots![/i]
[/center]
